novelty_standard: New rule, rule-defined outcome branch, or consequential timing/priority/exception interaction. Reject changed numbers, cosmetic wording or mechanical recombinations.
scope: English Repos base game, 2021 publication; sc-en01 rulebook copyright 2020. Standard setup, Choosing Clues, Resolution, scoring and endgame. Optional Add a Challenge excluded.

source_map.coverage_note: Equipment setup tested; component stock totals are descriptive inventory, not separate procedural questions.

source_map.procedure: Board/marker distribution, shuffled reachable face-down deck, four random hidden cards
Phase order; individual simultaneous secret phase; outside eight Keywords and four two-Keyword Pairs
Four connecting Clues, matching zones, single/compound words, five allowed categories
Keyword, translated Keyword, same-family and made-up Clue prohibitions
Advice for difficult Pairs and example associations
source_map.coverage_note: Advice and examples add no distinct binding rule; connection requirement tested.

source_map.procedure: Remove four; unseen fifth; shuffle five; face-down pile on board; wait for everyone
Choose first Spectator; no communication; one Spectator turn each; reveal board/five; reconstruct Pairs
Left-hand dispute authority; try layouts/discuss; verification after agreement
First perfect six (four plus two); first error silent incorrect-card removal to table and final retry
Wrongly oriented card marked incorrect and removed
source_map.coverage_note: Orientation is explicit in Q12 key; incorrect-card procedure in Q16. Fresh reviewer rejected candidate Q21 as redundant.

source_map.procedure: Second agreed layout; remove wrong cards; one point per correct card 0–4; no third attempt
Turn board over/write middle; discard all five; next Spectator left and new Resolution
End after each once; team sum; record; high-score goal
